WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO payment_callback_inbox ( callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at, paid_amount_yuan, status, idempotency_key, raw_payload_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{callbackNo}, #{orderNo}, #{externalTradeNo}, #{paymentProvider}, #{paidAt}, #{paidAmountYuan}, 'RECEIVED', #{idempotencyKey}, CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS jsonb), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM inserted UNION ALL SELECT FROM payment_callback_inbox WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) LIMIT 1

WITH picked AS ( SELECT id FROM payment_callback_inbox WHERE ( status = 'RECEIVED' OR ( status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) ) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), updated AS ( UPDATE payment_callback_inbox c SET status = 'PROCESSING', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM picked WHERE c.id = picked.id RETURNING c.* )
SELECT FROM updated
mapper.update: WITH result_rows AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{resultsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( callback_no text, status text, result_outcome text, result_order_status text, refund_no text, last_error_code text, last_error_message text, next_retry_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ) UPDATE payment_callback_inbox c SET status = result_rows.status, result_outcome = result_rows.result_outcome, result_order_status = result_rows.result_order_status, refund_no = result_rows.refund_no, last_error_code = result_rows.last_error_code, last_error_message = result_rows.last_error_message, retry_count = CASE WHEN result_rows.status = 'FAILED' THEN c.retry_count + 1 ELSE c.retry_count END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM result_rows WHERE c.callback_no = result_rows.callback_no AND c.status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM payment_callback_inbox
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
